text.title: EF Core Data Layer Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema for the EF data-layer manifest this methodology produces. Validator enforces required keys + per-field constraints.

section.title: Schema

example.note: dbcontext_name not PascalCase + missing suffix; provider unsupported; entity camelCase with public setters and data annotations; configuration class name lacks the `Configuration` suffix; repository returns `IQueryable` with no AsNoTracking and no split query; migration edits an already-merged file; AsNoTracking + concurrency audits failing; interceptor missing; SQL not reviewed.

list.item: Data annotations (`[Required]`, `[MaxLength]`) on an entity class.
Public setters on an entity property other than through the constructor or a mutating method.
A list repository method whose return type is not `PagedResult<TDto>`.
An edit or rename of a migration already merged to the deploy branch.
